entities.summary: Miro Gavran is a Croatian writer of short stories, fiction and drama. His works have been translated into 44 languages, making him the most translated Croatian writer, and his books have come out in 280 different editions at home and abroad. His dramas and comedies have had more than 450 theatre first nights around the world and have been seen by more than four million theatre attendants.
